title: Finland Severe Weather & Baltic Marine Alerts (FMI CAP/WFS) Input

modes.title: Data modes
modes.description: Select which FMI feeds to query: active_alerts (CAP 1.2 warnings), weather_observations (live synoptic station observations), sea_level_observations (Baltic mareograph stations).

language.title: Alert language
language.description: Language for FMI CAP weather warnings (en-GB or fi-FI).

minSeverity.title: Minimum CAP severity
minSeverity.description: Minimum CAP alert severity to include.

regionFilter.title: Region / Sea area filter
regionFilter.description: Optional substring filter on area or headline (e.g. 'Baltic', 'Uusimaa', 'Lapland').

includeCancelled.title: Include cancelled/removed alerts
includeCancelled.description: Whether to include CAP Cancel messages.

maxAlerts.title: Max alerts
maxAlerts.description: Maximum number of deduplicated CAP alerts to return.

places.title: Synoptic observation places
places.description: Finnish locations for live weather observations.

hoursBack.title: Observation lookback hours
hoursBack.description: Lookback window in hours for latest station observations.

maxSeaStations.title: Max coastal sea-level stations
maxSeaStations.description: Maximum number of Baltic mareograph stations to return.
